description: This file implements a fake timer and clock control system for testing purposes, including classes and functions to manipulate timers, date, performance, and other global timing APIs.

classes.name: ClockController
classes.description: A class that manages a simulated clock, timers, and time manipulation for testing purposes.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets the clock to a specific time.

methods.name: setSystemTime
methods.description: Sets the system time in the simulation.

methods.name: setFixedTime
methods.description: Sets a fixed time for the clock, disabling automatic time progression.

methods.name: performanceNow
methods.description: Returns a high-resolution timestamp based on the simulated clock.

methods.name: addTimer
methods.description: Adds a new timer of specified type and delay.

methods.name: clearTimer
methods.description: Clears a timer by ID and type.

methods.name: runFor
methods.description: Advances the clock by a specified number of ticks.

methods.name: pauseAt
methods.description: Pauses the clock at a specific time.

methods.name: resume
methods.description: Resumes the clock from a paused state.

methods.name: fastForward
methods.description: Fast-forwards the clock by a specified number of ticks.
